qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the deployment, start, and activation steps for the Bi-directional eDirectory driver as described on the page.
qa_pairs.output: The page explains that after installing and configuring the Bi-directional eDirectory driver, you must perform three actions: deploy the driver, start the driver, and activate the driver. Each action is covered in a separate section of the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide, with links to the detailed procedures.

qa_pairs.instruction: What does deploying the Bi-directional eDirectory driver mean, according to the documentation?
qa_pairs.output: Deploying the Bi-directional eDirectory driver means creating the driver object in NetIQ Identity Manager so that the driver becomes known to the system. The deployment process is described in the "Deploying the Driver" section of the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide.

qa_pairs.instruction: What is the purpose of starting the Bi-directional eDirectory driver?
qa_pairs.output: Starting the Bi-directional eDirectory driver launches the driver process so that it can begin processing provisioning and synchronization requests. The steps to start the driver are detailed in the "Starting the Driver" section of the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide.

qa_pairs.instruction: Why must the Bi-directional eDirectory driver be activated after it is started?
qa_pairs.output: Activating the Bi-directional eDirectory driver enables it to participate in Identity Manager operations. Activation registers the driver with the runtime environment, allowing it to receive and handle events. The activation procedure is covered in the "Activating Drivers" portion of the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you deploy the Bi-directional eDirectory driver?
qa_pairs.output: To deploy the Bi-directional eDirectory driver, open the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide and follow the "Deploying the Driver" section. That section provides step‑by‑step instructions for creating the driver object in the Designer, specifying the driver type as Bi-directional eDirectory, and saving the configuration.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you start the Bi-directional eDirectory driver after it has been deployed?
qa_pairs.output: After deploying the Bi-directional eDirectory driver, refer to the "Starting the Driver" section of the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide. The guide instructs you to locate the driver object in the Designer, select the Start action, and confirm that the driver status changes to "Running".

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you activate the Bi-directional eDirectory driver once it is running?
qa_pairs.output: To activate the Bi-directional eDirectory driver, follow the steps in the "Activating Drivers" chapter of the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide. Typically you select the driver object, choose the Activate command, and verify that the driver status shows as "Active" in the Administration console.
